note: Family-owned 10-acre campground on the Manistique River next to Seney NWR in Germfask, on the site of a 1935-42 CCC camp; some sites overlook the river. Mostly transient/nightly (one monthly full-hookup site offered for 2026). On-site canoe/kayak/tube livery. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026): $40 W/E 30-amp base, $45 full hookup (confirmed; tent W/E 20-amp $35 left out), 30-amp max with 9 full-hookup sites, 6 pull-throughs, bathhouse with flush toilets/showers/laundry, dump, store, fiber wifi; online via ResNexus or phone. Changed season close 09-30 -> 10-18 (2026: May 1 - Oct 18); added electric 30, cleared the Good Sam-directory military discount. Site count 50 (derived) not stated by the operator; left. Note cleaned of hookup/site/facility/season/booking text (its '8 pull-through' contradicts the operator's 6).
